note: OURS, not scraped. Every other file in this directory is a verbatim capture of eqlwiki.com; this one corrects the handful of mob pages whose stated loot is provably split or incomplete, so a mob card says what the creature can drop rather than what one wiki page happened to record. A fix is GUARDED - it applies only while the corpus still carries the error it corrects - and CITED, naming the evidence in `why`. See Sources/EQKnowledge/MobLootFixes.swift.

aliases.why: Two pages for one creature. The game writes only 'a revultant rat' (9,719 lines of a 769k-line Plane of Hate log; 'repulsive' appears zero times). Both pages sit in Plane of Hate and both list Revultant Whip, and Ruby, Diamond and Blue Diamond - looted from revultant rats - are stated only on the 'repulsive' page. Unmerged, the card shows one bracer per class and exactly one warrior item; the 'repulsive' page is where the armour is, and all 15 pieces of it (the full Indicolite and Legionnaire Scale sets) are WAR.

Two pages for one creature. 'loathling' is the only spelling the game writes (7,019 lines; 'loathing' zero). The two tables are disjoint - one carries the armour, the other the gems - and Black Sapphire, Blue Diamond, Jacinth, Ruby and Crystallized Sulfur, all looted from loathling liches, are stated only on the 'loathing' page.

One creature under two punctuations. `mobKey` folds the backtick to an apostrophe, so both pages claim one key and MobIndex keeps whichever it met first - silently discarding the other's Star Ruby, Fire Emerald and Sapphire. The game writes the backtick; the apostrophe page carries the 18 armour drops, so it stays canonical and the merge only recovers what was being thrown away.

Looted Lustrous Russet Helm +2 on Thu Sep 03 2026 in Plane of Hate. The page lists that line's Bracer already.
Looted Wand of Souls +1 on Thu Sep 03 2026 in Plane of Hate. On neither of the lich's two pages; the creature already drops Wand of Conflagration.
